name_story.story: Makki can be understood through the Arabic form مكي, whose central sense is meccan, of mecca. Makki is Arabic مَكِّيّ (Makkiyy) 'Meccan, of Mecca', the nisba of مَكَّة (Makka). The source gloss 'From Mecca' is consistent.

faq.a: Makki is associated with the Arabic form مكي, whose core sense is meccan, of mecca.

faq.q: What is the origin of Makki?
faq.a: Makki is associated with Arabic. Makki is Arabic مَكِّيّ (Makkiyy) 'Meccan, of Mecca', the nisba of مَكَّة (Makka). The source gloss 'From Mecca' is consistent.
Yes — the underlying form مكي is Arabic.
Makki can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Makki mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Makki is rendered مکی and carries the sense مکی، مکہ سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Makki mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Makki is rendered مکی and carries the sense مکی، منسوب به مکه.
A romanized syllable approximation is mak-ki. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Makki?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Makki, makki. Script forms are مكي, مکي, مکی, मक्की.

faq.q: Is Makki a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
